texts.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。
texts.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the solar winds created by starlight.
